cover_subtitle: Learn the quick fix for YouTube API hiccups.

slides.title: Step 1 – Get the API key
slides.body: Sign in to Google Cloud, create a project → enable YouTube Data API → copy the key.

slides.title: Step 2 – Call the API
slides.body: Use curl or Postman → send GET to https://youtube.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/captions?videoId=XYZ&key=YOURKEY.

slides.title: Step 3 – Feed to Claude
slides.body: Pass the transcript text as input → ask for a 200‑word summary → get the output instantly.

slides.title: Step 4 – Add user accounts
slides.body: Create a sign‑up page → store email and password securely → track transcript count per user.

slides.title: Step 5 – Fix the newsletter
slides.body: Re‑build the scheduler → test with a test list → schedule Monday sends.

last_slide: Follow for more hands‑on builds from Malaysia.
